notes: All art is newly generated for this project; no external model or texture assets.
No gameplay, damage, collection, camera or controller code is modified.
Original preserved scene is not exported.
Visual walls are 3.7m; levels 5m apart; slab thickness 0.36m; no top roof for cutaway visibility.
Head look must be clamped; original source did not establish independent head turn.
Use ramp collision for stairs and real cut-out floor mesh; never whole-level AABB.
Dry cistern front lip has a 3m-wide walking entry, not a fully enclosing obstacle.

Gold revision: crystals field is legacy alias; actual visuals are dirt mound / wood boxes. Box collision proxies and AABBs must be registered in runtime physics; visual meshes alone do not block Three.js characters.
Spike revision: former clear hole landings are now intentional hazards. Hazard volumes are triggers, not solid full-height AABBs; only thin bases are solid.
